title: Austin's Agenda: Homelessness & Airport Talk
summary:
*   City leaders held a work session to address the issue of homelessness.
*   A report was given and discussed regarding the Austin Municipal Airport contract.
*   Items requiring confidential executive session review were also on the agenda.
